description: Auto-emit one Dagster asset per Qlik Compose Workflow / Data Mart across every Project (Data Warehouse). StateBackedComponent — discovery cached to disk. Materializing a Workflow asset runs the workflow to terminal state; Data Mart assets are observational. The workspace-shape peer of the low-level qlik_compose_* components.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per selected item discovered in the vendor. See README for what each materialization produces.

projects.description: Optional whitelist of Compose project (data-warehouse) names. None means all discoverable projects.
projects.label: Projects Filter

workflow_selector.label: Workflow Selector
workflow_selector.description: Fivetran-shape selector: by_name / by_pattern / exclude_by_name / exclude_by_pattern.

group_name.description: Group name for all imported assets.
group_name.label: Group Name

asset_key_prefix.description: Key prefix used for all emitted AssetKeys.
asset_key_prefix.label: Asset Key Prefix

compute_kind.description: Compute kind tag for all imported assets.
compute_kind.label: Compute Kind

wait_for_completion.description: When true, workflow-asset materializations block until the Compose workflow reaches a terminal state (COMPLETED / STOPPED / ERROR / FAILED). When false, fire-and-forget.
wait_for_completion.label: Wait for Completion

poll_interval_seconds.description: Interval between Compose workflow-state polls when waiting.
poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval (s)

defs_state.description: State backend for cached workspace discovery. Local filesystem by default. Overridden per-deploy for prod runs against Dagster Cloud.
defs_state.label: Defs State Config
